trials.failure: visible-window measurement interrupted: external key input

methodology.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW in parent and native process metrics; launch timestamp immediately before subprocess creation
methodology.startup: fresh process with normal filesystem/driver caches; includes interpreter, host/font/GPU setup and controlled Python child; not a cold-cache or login-shell benchmark
methodology.first_present: return from the first successful WGPU compositor presentation, possibly before child output
methodology.ready_present: successful presentation return after parsing child readiness and verifying matching visible model text
methodology.input: synthetic text callback through real input encoding, PTY delivery, numbered child acknowledgment, parsing and successful WGPU presentation return
methodology.association: one outstanding sequence; unrelated output or frames cannot complete an input sample
methodology.phase_diagnostics: while input is pending, bounded read/parse/prepare/render/wait/flush wall and process-CPU counters are retained for failed and slowest measured acknowledgments; process CPU includes native worker threads and can exceed wall time; instrumentation adds clock reads
methodology.load: bounded nonblocking child output started by first warmup input; region mode scrolls below the acknowledgment row; history mode scrolls the full primary screen and repaints a top-right acknowledgment between lines
methodology.sampling: warmup inputs excluded; startup has one observation per fresh process; pooled input summaries are diagnostic and not independent process-level samples
methodology.exclusions: physical input delivery, IME, GPU completion, compositor display feedback and panel scan-out are not measured
methodology.memory: sampled process RSS after successful presentations; not OS high-water RSS
methodology.bounds: explicit internal deadline plus ten seconds for external cleanup; two-second acknowledgment ceiling; at most 256 measured inputs, 32 warmup inputs and 256 resource observations per trial

soak_policy.growth: last-quarter minus first-quarter median of post-warmup presentation samples; no forced GC
soak_policy.history: resource samples include actual retained rows, pushes and evictions to distinguish capacity filling from steady-state growth; budgets remain unchanged
soak_policy.sampling: bounded periodic observations on successful presents; no additional wake timer; CPU percent can exceed 100 on multiple cores
